facts: Female dogs are only ready to mate–"in heat"–twice a year for a total of roughly 20 days.
Perky-eared dogs hear sounds better than floppy-eared dogs.
Dogs don’t go into menopause and will continue to go on heat indefinitely unless they are spayed.
The most popular male dog name is Max, while the most popular female dog name is Bella.
A dog's sense of smell is so powerful that they can detect a drop of blood in a large swimming pool.
